lesson.grammar_point: present continuous (am / is / are + -ing) for what is happening now

listenings.text: Hi Rodrigo, it is Lucia. I am calling from the shipping area. We are loading the truck right now, and the driver is waiting outside. The quality team is checking the last batch, so we are not closing the order today. I am sending you a message when the truck leaves. Talk to you later.

Good afternoon. Here is the update for today. The flavor line is running normally. The fragrance line is stopping for two hours this afternoon, because we are changing a machine. Nobody is working in that area during the change. The schedule is not changing, and we are finishing the week on time. Thank you.

extra_audio.text: The week starts on Monday with the production plan. The flavor line is running three batches. The quality lab is testing the samples from France. The team is printing the new labels. On Friday everything is finishing on time.

paras: This is the status report for week thirty-eight. Right now the plant is working at ninety percent.
The flavor line is running three batches this week. The team is finishing the last batch on Thursday.
The quality lab is testing two samples from France. They are not ready yet, so we are waiting for the result.
We are printing the new labels this week, and the schedule is not changing. Everything is on time.
